question: From the body of a solid cube of edge 7 cm, a solid sphere is removed. The volume of the remaining solid was found to be {{163}}frac{{{1}}}{{{3}}} cm³. What is the diameter (in cm) of the sphere? (Take {{pi = }}frac{{{{22}}}}{{{7}}} )
solution:
**Given:**

Edge of cube = 7cm

**Concept used:**

Volume of a cube = a³

Volume of a sphere = (4/3)πr³

Here,

a = side or edge of the cube

r = radius of the sphere

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the sphere be x cm

According to the question,

a³ - (4/3)πr³ = {{163}}frac{{{1}}}{{{3}}}

⇒ 7³ - (4)/(3)πr³ = {{}}frac{{{490}}}{{{3}}}

⇒ 343 - {{}}frac{{{490}}}{{{3}}} = (4)/(3)πr3

⇒ {{}}frac{{{1029 - 490}}}{{{3}}} = (4)/(3)πr3

⇒ {{}}frac{{{539}}}{{{3}}} = (4)/(3)πr3

⇒ 539 = 4πr3

⇒ (539 × 7)/(22 × 4) = r3

⇒ 42.875 = r3

⇒ r = 3.5 cm

So, diameter = 3.5 × 2 = 7 cm

**∴ The diameter (in cm) of the sphere is 7.**
